name: B10-0327/2025 (S&D, Verts/ALE) – Arbitrary arrest and torture of Belgian-Portuguese researcher Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the arbitrary arrest and torture of Belgian-Portuguese researcher Joseph Figueira Martin in the Central African Republic
part_text:
The European Parliament is not changing any law here. It is asking the Central African Republic to free Joseph Figueira Martin, a Belgian-Portuguese researcher held for over a year without trial. It says he was tortured, his health has badly worsened, and doctors want him evacuated. It asks the country to let him see a lawyer, get consular help and proper care, and to stop armed groups making illegal arrests. It also asks the European Union to push for his release.

- Nothing changes yet; this is an appeal, not a law.
- It concerns Joseph Figueira Martin and the Central African Republic.
- Next: the EU is urged to raise his case with that country's government.
